payout_quote: Official VIPKid 'Teacher Pay' page (vipkid.com/teach/teacher-pay): 'Q: How are earnings calculated? A: Earn $14-$22 an hour, with total earnings ranging from $15.6 - $28.4 per hour including various incentives.' And: 'The base pay is $14 per hour. Take advantage of VIPKid's bonuses and incentives and earn up to $22 per hour.' And: 'Teachers may choose to be paid weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly. Your payment date is based on your preference.'
steps: Apply as a VIPKid teacher (bachelor's degree + 2 years teaching/tutoring/coaching/mentoring experience).
Complete the application: form, materials review, demo lesson, and mock class.
Sign the 6-month contract; set your availability in the VIPKid Teach App.
Teach 25-minute one-on-one classes; paid $14-$22/hr base (up to $28.4/hr with incentives), weekly/bi-weekly/monthly.
catches: The $14-$22/hr is base pay; the higher end ($28.4/hr) requires incentives — your actual rate depends on experience, demo, and qualifications.
Requires a bachelor's degree AND at least two years of teaching/tutoring/coaching/mentoring experience — selective.
Must be legally eligible to work in the US or Canada.
Classes are 25 minutes; earnings depend on bookings — no minimum hour commitment, but also no guaranteed volume.
biggest_catch: VIPKid requires a bachelor's degree plus two years of experience and US/Canada work authorization — and while $14-$22/hr is advertised, your base rate is set by VIPKid based on your credentials, with the top end dependent on incentives.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree (any field) + 2 years teaching/tutoring/coaching/mentoring experience; US/Canada work authorization.
timing: Weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly pay (teacher's choice) via bank/PayPal.
